interactionWindow.definition: first keydown through last keyup plus 1000 ms settlement

notes: Profile contains negative timestamp deltas; samples sorted by absolute timestamp before weighting to next sample, preventing overlapping weight.
Inclusive samples overlap and must not be added.
Durations are recorded under 6x emulation; not native phone timings.
Native API self samples may include browser/driver work or synchronization; this CPU trace cannot measure GPU execution duration.
Asset basenames only; no raw URLs, query strings, source text or user payloads retained.
